page0.text:
The golden sword appears in Saber's hands.
Berserker's grip on Tohsaka tightens.
I'm powerless... I'm going to let all three of us die.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page0:1

page1.text:
"...Kngh!"
Is that really our only option?
Is our only chance at victory using up the last of Saber's magical energy for her Noble Phantasm and so endangering her existence?
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page1:1

page2.text:
"EX..."
The giant releases Tohsaka and charges at Saber.
"CALIBUR!!!!!!"
He meets the sacred sword as it sweeps the earth ahead of it.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page2:1

page3.text:
"...Ah!"
The silver armor collapses.
Saber falls to her knees, having converted the last of her magical energy into light.
In front of her, Berserker remains intact.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page3:1

page4.text: "That's the end for you, Saber. Even the mighty sacred sword isn't strong enough with such a pathetic amount of magical energy."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page4:1

page5.text:
Saber's starting to fade.
She must not even have the strength to stand. Unable to rise, she looks up at Berserker.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page5:1

page6.text:
"Fufu. You must be disappointed too, Berserker.
If only Saber had been at full power, you might've had a chance to die!"
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page6:1

page7.text:
The giant sword swings down.
Berserker doesn't wait for Saber to disappear. He crushes her.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page7:1

page8.text:
"Sa...ber..."
Saber disappears.
I knew this would happen.
If Saber used her sacred sword, she would disappear no matter the outcome of the battle.
I knew, but I didn't stop her...
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page8:1

page9.text:
"It's all over. So what will you do now, brother? Will you try to run away, or will you just let me kill you?
Oh, I know! If you say you'll let me kill you, I'll let Rin go."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page9:1

page10.text:
...
I can't even think.
Saber's corpse is right in front of me. It's already become one with the earth.
I can't escape.
If I can't escape no matter what I do, at least...
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page10:1

page11.text:
"Teehee. Good boy, Shirou.
Bring him to me, Berserker. Make sure he can't run away."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page11:1

page12.text:
A rush of wind obliterates everything below my waist.
My senses are utterly overwhelmed with pain and despair.
I'm fading.
In the middle of the clearing, Tohsaka's body is sprawled on the ground, long since having gone motionless.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-13:page12:1
